name: baseplate
about: Agent-native VFX and sounds for Roblox. Copy files from baseUrl+src to dest in the user's project, then do each 'after' step. Install 'requires' first.

items.name: juice
items.description: The runtime every item needs: Juice.play, Juice.vfx, Juice.sfx, Juice.music.
after: Skip copying a file that already exists; never overwrite the user's Sounds.luau.

items.name: coin_pickup
items.description: Gold sparkle burst with a soft glow.

items.name: hit
items.description: Sharp white-orange impact sparks with a flash.

items.name: level_up
items.description: Rising column of blue sparkles with an expanding ring.

items.name: confetti
items.description: Colourful confetti that pops up and flutters down.

items.name: explosion
items.description: Fireball, flying embers and lingering smoke. Visual only.

items.name: coin_pickup
after: Ask the user to upload assets/sfx/coin_pickup.ogg as an Audio asset (Creator Hub > Creations > Upload, or Open Cloud Assets API) and give you its asset ID.
Add this line inside the Sounds table in src/shared/Juice/Sounds.luau, with the real ID: coin_pickup = { id = "ASSET_ID", volume = 0.5, pitchVariance = 0.05 },
